# UpstreamDrift agent discovery hints

- Headless simulation MCP server: `ud-sim-mcp` (`src.sim_run.mcp`, `.mcp.json` entry).
- Fleet Agent API v1 conformance template: `config/fleet_agent_api_conformance/v1/template.json`.
- CI runner: `python3 scripts/run_agent_api_conformance.py` (requires `pip install -e '.[sim-mcp]'`).
- Capability inventory: `docs/development/sim_run_mcp_capability_inventory.md`.
